writeup: Woot has open-box Skechers Hands Free Slip-ins Breathe Easy Home Body in Dark Taupe (style 100615) for $25.64. You just step in with no hands needed, and the insole is Skechers' Air-Cooled Memory Foam. Zappos sells the same style for $69.98 and Martin's lists it at $84.99, so this is about 63% less. Skechers' own site shows this style sold out, the Woot listing doesn't state a size, and the limit is two per order.
